title: Mercantile
summary: MER'CANTILE, adjective [Latin mercans, mercor, to buy.] 1. Trading; commercial; carrying on commerce; as mercantile nations; the mercantile class of men. 2. Pertaining or relating to commerce or trade

inlines.v: MER'CANTILE, adjective [Latin mercans, mercor, to buy.] 1. Trading; commercial; carrying on commerce; as mercantile nations; the mercantile class of men. 2. Pertaining or relating to commerce or trade; as mercantile business.
